about:
The Bonsai 1.58b release introduces the next major evolutionary leap in extreme edge AI. While the 1.0b release proved that LLMs could function on pure binary logic, the 1.58b release leverages the revolutionary BitNet b1.58 Architecture, introducing a native ternary state. By representing weights as {-1, 0, +1}, this release achieves the holy grail of quantization: near full-precision (FP16) accuracy with the memory and speed profile of a 1-bit model.

The Power of the Zero State
In a pure binary network (-1, +1), every parameter is forced to actively contribute to the output, which can sometimes lead to noisy activations. The Bonsai 1.58b architecture introduces the crucial 'zero' state. This seemingly simple addition allows the neural network to explicitly filter out irrelevant features by assigning them a zero weight, effectively turning off unnecessary connections during inference.

This results in a model that is exponentially more accurate, hallucination-resistant, and contextually aware than its binary predecessors, while requiring exactly the same integer-addition hardware logic. It effectively operates at 1.58 bits per weight, completely bypassing traditional Matrix Multiplication (MatMul) operations.

Uncompromising Fidelity at the Edge
The primary mission of the Bonsai 1.58b release is to completely erase the performance gap between cloud-based AI and local-edge AI. By utilizing ternary weights, these models demonstrate perplexity and benchmark scores that rival unquantized 16-bit models. Yet, they require an astonishingly small memory footprint.

With Bonsai 1.58b, complex instruction following, advanced reasoning, multilingual translation, and intricate coding assistance are fully localized. Models that perform at a desktop-class level now seamlessly fit into the RAM of standard smartphones and lightweight laptops.

The Standard for Silicon Sovereignty
Bonsai 1.58b is built for a future where high-density intelligence is decentralized. It empowers Silicon Sovereignty, allowing enterprises and individual developers to host highly capable AI entirely offline. It provides zero latency with no cloud round-trips, ensuring instantaneous response times. It ensures absolute privacy where data never leaves the device. It champions Green AI with tremendous reductions in power consumption and thermal load.

The Bonsai 1.58b release sets a new global standard. It proves that we no longer have to choose between extreme efficiency and extreme intelligence, we can now deploy both, simultaneously, on any silicon.

bonsai1.58:1.7b.name: Bonsai 1.58b 1.7B
bonsai1.58:1.7b.description: The Bonsai 1.58b 1.7B represents a leap in extreme edge AI, featuring native ternary (1.58-bit) weight quantization with {-1, 0, +1} states. This 'zero' state dramatically boosts feature filtering while keeping memory footprint under ~500MB. Replacing MatMul with pure addition logic, it ensures zero-latency offline performance on highly constrained silicon, like smartphones or IoT. It guarantees absolute privacy, minimal thermal load, and a 32k context window for real-time edge processing.

bonsai1.58:4b.name: Bonsai 1.58b 4B
bonsai1.58:4b.description: The Bonsai 1.58b 4B is a highly balanced ternary cognitive engine designed for premium edge devices. Utilizing the BitNet b1.58 architecture, this 4 billion parameter network retains near-FP16 fidelity while requiring a mere 1.2GB of RAM. Operating entirely offline, it guarantees Silicon Sovereignty, ensuring secure, fast intelligence without cloud dependence. With a 64k context window, it bridges the gap between mobile and desktop AI, perfectly tuned for complex reasoning and battery efficiency.

bonsai1.58:8b.name: Bonsai 1.58b 8B
bonsai1.58:8b.description: The Bonsai 1.58b 8B is the definitive flagship of the ternary AI frontier. This 8 billion parameter titan utilizes {-1, 0, +1} weight states to achieve unprecedented cognitive depth, demanding only ~2.2GB of RAM. Abandoning standard MatMul for addition-only logic, it executes desktop-class intelligence natively on standard laptops. With a massive 128k context window, it excels in professional coding and deep reasoning, guaranteeing zero-latency sovereign deployment without thermal throttling.

bonsai1.58:27b.name: Bonsai 1.58b 27B
bonsai1.58:27b.description: The Bonsai 1.58b 27B brings massive 27 billion parameter intelligence to standard devices. Utilizing native ternary (1.58-bit) weight quantization with {-1, 0, +1} states, it achieves near-FP16 fidelity while compressing to ~7.2GB. Designed for extreme edge deployment without cloud dependence.
